From your condo, you can walk to restaurants, ice cream, and marinas for fishing charters, dolphin cruises, and more. You’re also only a mile from Perdido Pass, The Gulf Orange Beach, and several other shops and restaurants. Nearby you’ll find arcades, amusement parks, shopping, dining, and more. faqs.question: Does Phoenix VI have accessibility options?
faqs.answer: Phoenix VI Orange Beach is equipped with accessibility features to ensure that guests can enjoy their stay. The resort has accessible entrances and public areas, including ramps and elevators. The units were also originally designed with accessibility in mind. Contact us at 1-800-211-7892 to discuss accommodations and options.
